text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Gold City's running today, huh~ Can't wait to see how well she does against the Senior class~

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're just saying nice things to flatter me.
You're only after my face anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Caught me, huh? I really am looking forward to the race, but I'm super happy to see the real deal in person too! You feel the same way, right~?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm only here for Tamamo Cross.
Did you see that race where she won by a landslide?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! That was totally mind-blowing!
I wonder what kind of run she'll show us today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, who are you!?
...Wait, Gold City!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: S-So breathtakingly pretty...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
It's fine now. Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I said it's fine. ...Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like Tamamo-senpai overcame her hurdle.
What a relief...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So, for me—it's "just for the face," huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I know. I'm okay.
Right now, I'll focus on running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So……
Please, don't say anything more.
Those opinions earlier were only a fraction of the whole, and there are plenty saying they're 'looking forward to her run.' But telling her that won't bring any comfort. In that case—
choice_data_list: Keep your head up and run as only you can

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—I finally get to run with ya.
Sorry to keep you waiting, City!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to this for ages, ya know?
You seemed to be riding high all this time, but that ends today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's gonna knock you right off your high horse!
Don't you go cryin', 'Tamamo-senpai's too strong~!' either!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Like hell I'd cry...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know what happened,
but what's with that total lack of drive before a race?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...What the heck.
You mean I was the only one...?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
Wipe that spaced-out look off your face!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I ain't gonna let ya run sloppy.
...Just don't get in my way when I make my move!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna look lame doing it,
I'd rather not run at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...
However.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If there's still a chance...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I have to go.
